b: In this month’s antidote to the algorithm, Juliet Jacques explores the playful and experimental soundtracks to games on the popular tape-based home computer

I spent my first year at the University of Manchester in halls of residence. They put me in with a group of lads who were really into techno, and drum and bass – a challenge to my sensibilities, as I had a tribal allegiance to punk, post-punk and independent music. During our first weeks together, in September 2000, a single came out that instantly became a massive hit but united my flatmates in disgust: ‘Kernkraft 400’ by Zombie Nation.
